note: the commissioning service's development sites and window (environment/commission_service/commissiond.py). Readable by the service's account only.
rule: development sites: the first seeds from 7001 on, in order, until together they show every build option of the equipment manual (mirrored or not, the flow meter first or not, the station's groups either way round, every valve-style choice of V-101, V-103, V-104, V-102, V-112 and V-302, every gauge scale), every fault type and a demand step up and down at least once: 35 features, 9 sites (7001-7009; every valve the previous shift may leave out of place is out of place on one of them). None is a graded site or a candidate of the hidden set's selection (checked by tests/test_pump_skid_commissioning.py).
